{"parentUuid":"0a88d148-32e2-46c3-a59e-1d8155ff586b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_89bz0otaccvef3x8ogmasdf2","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp20/b/src/oj/Checker.java","content":"package oj;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * Validates declared constraints against the data actually loaded in a\n * {@link Catalog}. Used in two places:\n * <ol>\n *   <li>the {@code validate} action — report whether every constraint holds;</li>\n *   <li>the rewriter under policy {@code validate_all} — a rewrite premise\n *       that fails validation here blocks the rewrite and is reported as\n *       {@code REJECTED_VIOLATED}.</li>\n * </ol>\n */\npublic final class Checker {\n\n    public record Violation(String constraint, String kind, String detail,\n                            Map<String, Object> exampleRow) {}\n\n    public record Result(boolean holds, List<Violation> violations) {}\n\n    private final Catalog cat;\n\n    public Checker(Catalog cat) { this.cat = cat; }\n\n    public Result check(Catalog.Constraint c) {\n        return switch (c) {\n            case Catalog.Unique u -> checkUnique(u.table(), u.columns(), u);\n            case Catalog.PrimaryKey pk -> checkPrimaryKey(pk);\n            case Catalog.NotNull nn -> checkNotNull(nn);\n            case Catalog.ForeignKey fk -> checkForeignKey(fk);\n        };\n    }\n\n    public Result checkAll() {\n        List<Violation> all = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Catalog.Constraint c : cat.allConstraints()) {\n            Result r = check(c);\n            if (!r.holds()) all.addAll(r.violations());\n        }\n        return new Result(all.isEmpty(), all);\n    }\n\n    private Result checkPrimaryKey(Catalog.PrimaryKey pk) {\n        List<Violation> v = new ArrayList<>();\n        Result u = checkUnique(pk.table(), pk.columns(), pk);\n        v.addAll(u.violations());\n        // UNIQUE alone allows NULLs; a primary key must not\n        Catalog.Table t = cat.table(pk.table());\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : t.rows) {\n            for (String col : pk.columns()) {\n                if (row.get(t.canon(col)) == null) {\n                    v.add(new Violation(pk.name(), pk.kind(),\n                            \"null value in primary-key column \" + pk.table() + \".\" + col,\n                            display(row)));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return new Result(v.isEmpty(), v);\n    }\n\n    private Result checkUnique(String table, List<String> cols, Catalog.Constraint c) {\n        Catalog.Table t = cat.table(table);\n        requireColumns(t, cols);\n        Map<List<Object>, Map<String, Object>> seen = new HashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : t.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (String col : cols) key.add(Value.key(row.get(t.canon(col))));\n            // SQL UNIQUE treats all-NULL rows as distinct from each other;\n            // a row with any null does not participate in duplicate detection.\n            if (key.stream().allMatch(k -> k == Value.key(null))) continue;\n            if (seen.containsKey(key)) {\n                Violation v = new Violation(c.name(), c.kind(),\n                        \"duplicate key \" + keyView(cols, row, t) + \" in \" + c.table(),\n                        display(row));\n                return new Result(false, List.of(v));\n            }\n            seen.put(key, row);\n        }\n        return new Result(true, List.of());\n    }\n\n    private Result checkNotNull(Catalog.NotNull nn) {\n        Catalog.Table t = cat.table(nn.table());\n        requireColumns(t, List.of(nn.column()));\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : t.rows) {\n            if (row.get(t.canon(nn.column())) == null) {\n                return new Result(false, List.of(new Violation(nn.name(), nn.kind(),\n                        \"null value in \" + nn.table() + \".\" + nn.column(), display(row))));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Result(true, List.of());\n    }\n\n    private Result checkForeignKey(Catalog.ForeignKey fk) {\n        Catalog.Table child = cat.table(fk.table());\n        Catalog.Table parent = cat.table(fk.refTable());\n        requireColumns(child, fk.columns());\n        requireColumns(parent, fk.refColumns());\n        java.util.Set<List<Object>> parentKeys = new java.util.HashSet<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : parent.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (String col : fk.refColumns()) key.add(Value.key(row.get(parent.canon(col))));\n            parentKeys.add(key);\n        }\n        for (Map<String, Object> crow : child.rows) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            boolean anyNull = false;\n            for (String col : fk.columns()) {\n                Object v = crow.get(child.canon(col));\n                if (v == null) anyNull = true;\n                key.add(Value.key(v));\n            }\n            // SQL: a FK row with any NULL child column is not checked.\n            if (anyNull) continue;\n            if (!parentKeys.contains(key)) {\n                return new Result(false, List.of(new Violation(fk.name(), fk.kind(),\n                        \"row in \" + fk.table() + \" has no matching parent in \"\n                                + fk.refTable() + \" for key (\" + String.join(\",\", fk.columns()) + \")\",\n                        display(crow))));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Result(true, List.of());\n    }\n\n    private void requireColumns(Catalog.Table t, List<String> cols) {\n        for (String c : cols) {\n            if (!t.columns.contains(c))\n                throw new Json.JException(\"constraint references unknown column \" + t.name + \".\" + c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private String keyView(List<String> cols, Map<String, Object> row, Catalog.Table t) {\n        List<String> parts = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : cols) parts.add(c + \"=\" + Json.write(row.get(t.canon(c))));\n        return \"(\" + String.join(\", \", parts) + \")\";\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> display(Map<String, Object> row) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : row.entrySet())\n            m.put(e.getKey().substring(e.getKey().indexOf('.') + 1), e.getValue());\n        return m;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_ee21a10a4a31a73e488b25a1","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":567,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":51000,"output_tokens":1629,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_89bz0otaccvef3x8ogmasdf2":{"content":"package No SQL engine is used; joins, filters,\n * projections and DISTINCT are implemented directly over {@code Map} rows.\n *\n * <p>Rows in the middle of the tree are maps keyed by {@code alias.column}.\n * After a Project, rows are keyed by output column name.\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    public record Result(List<String> columns, List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {\n        public int rowCount() { return rows.size(); }\n    }\n\n    private final Catalog cat;\n\n    public Executor(Catalog cat) { this.cat = cat; }\n\n    public Result execute(Plan.Node plan) {\n        return switch (plan) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> {\n                Catalog.Table t = cat.table(s.table());\n                List<String> cols = t.columns.stream().map(c -> s.alias() + \".\" + c).toList();\n                yield new Result(cols, cat.bind(t, s.alias()));\n            }\n            case Plan.Filter f -> {\n                Result in = execute(f.input());\n                List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Map<String, Object> row : in.rows())\n                    if (Value.isTrue((Boolean) f.pred().eval(row))) out.add(row);\n                yield new Result(in.columns(), out);\n            }\n            case Plan.Project p -> {\n                Result in = execute(p.input());\n                List<String> outCols = p.items().stream().map(Plan.ProjItem::alias).toList();\n                List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n                Set<List<Object>> seen = new HashSet<>();\n                for (Map<String, Object> row : in.rows()) {\n                    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    List<Object> distinctKey = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Plan.ProjItem item : p.items()) {\n                        Object v = item.expr().eval(row);\n                        m.put(item.alias(), v);\n                        distinctKey.add(Value.key(v));\n                    }\n                    if (!p.distinct() || seen.add(distinctKey)) rows.add(m);\n                }\n                yield new Result(outCols, rows);\n            }\n            case Plan.Join j -> join(j);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Result join(Plan.Join j) {\n        Result l = execute(j.left());\n        Result r = execute(j.right());\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>(l.columns());\n        cols.addAll(r.columns());\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        boolean[] rightMatched = new boolean[r.rows().size()];\n        for (Map<String, Object> lr : l.rows()) {\n            boolean matched = false;\n            for (int ri = 0; ri < r.rows().size(); ri++) {\n                Map<String, Object> rr = r.rows().get(ri);\n                Map<String, Object> combined = combine(lr, rr);\n                if (j.on() == null || Value.isTrue((Boolean) j.on().eval(combined))) {\n                    out.add(combined);\n                    matched = true;\n                    rightMatched[ri] = true;\n                }\n            }\n            if ((j.joinType().equals(\"left\") || j.joinType().equals(\"full\")) && !matched)\n                out.add(combine(lr, nulls(r.columns())));\n        }\n        if (j.joinType().equals(\"right\") || j.joinType().equals(\"full\")) {\n            for (int ri = 0; ri < r.rows().size(); ri++) {\n                if (rightMatched[ri]) continue;\n                out.add(combine(nulls(l.columns()), r.rows().get(ri)));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Result(cols, out);\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> combine(Map<String, Object> a, Map<String, Object> b) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>(a.size() + (b == null ? 0 : b.size()));\n        m.putAll(a);\n        if (b != null) m.putAll(b);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> nulls(List<String> cols) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (String c : cols) m.put(c, null);\n        return m;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5be7377f4df32356b653993f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2224,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":51000,"output_tokens":1193,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_nsf62yty3r5chwjsj4a3home":{"content":"package No SQL engine is used; joins, filters,\n * projections and DISTINCT are implemented directly over {@code Map} rows.\n *\n * <p>Rows in the middle of the tree are maps keyed by {@code alias.column}.\n * After a Project, rows are keyed by output column name.\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    public record Result(List<String> columns, List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {\n        public int rowCount() { return rows.size(); }\n    }\n\n    private final Catalog cat;\n\n    public Executor(Catalog cat) { this.cat = cat; }\n\n    public Result execute(Plan.Node plan) {\n        return switch (plan) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> {\n                Catalog.Table t = cat.table(s.table());\n                List<String> cols = t.columns.stream().map(c -> s.alias() + \".\" + c).toList();\n                yield new Result(cols, cat.bind(t, s.alias()));\n            }\n            case Plan.Filter f -> {\n                Result in = execute(f.input());\n                List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Map<String, Object> row : in.rows())\n                    if (Value.isTrue((Boolean) f.pred().eval(row))) out.add(row);\n                yield new Result(in.columns(), out);\n            }\n            case Plan.Project p -> {\n                Result in = execute(p.input());\n                List<String> outCols = p.items().stream().map(Plan.ProjItem::alias).toList();\n                List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n                Set<List<Object>> seen = new HashSet<>();\n                for (Map<String, Object> row : in.rows()) {\n                    Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    List<Object> distinctKey = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Plan.ProjItem item : p.items()) {\n                        Object v = item.expr().eval(row);\n                        m.put(item.alias(), v);\n                        distinctKey.add(Value.key(v));\n                    }\n                    if (!p.distinct() || seen.add(distinctKey)) rows.add(m);\n                }\n                yield new Result(outCols, rows);\n            }\n            case Plan.Join j -> join(j);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Result join(Plan.Join j) {\n        Result l = execute(j.left());\n        Result r = execute(j.right());\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>(l.columns());\n        cols.addAll(r.columns());\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        boolean[] rightMatched = new boolean[r.rows().size()];\n        for (Map<String, Object> lr : l.rows()) {\n            boolean matched = false;\n            for (int ri = 0; ri < r.rows().size(); ri++) {\n                Map<String, Object> rr = r.rows().get(ri);\n                Map<String, Object> combined = combine(lr, rr);\n                if (j.on() == null || Value.isTrue((Boolean) j.on().eval(combined))) {\n                    out.add(combined);\n                    matched = true;\n                    rightMatched[ri] = true;\n                }\n            }\n            if ((j.joinType().equals(\"left\") || j.joinType().equals(\"full\")) && !matched)\n                out.add(combine(lr, nulls(r.columns())));\n        }\n        if (j.joinType().equals(\"right\") || j.joinType().equals(\"full\")) {\n            for (int ri = 0; ri < r.rows().size(); ri++) {\n                if (rightMatched[ri]) continue;\n                out.add(combine(nulls(l.columns()), r.rows().get(ri)));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Result(cols, out);\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> combine(Map<String, Object> a, Map<String, Object> b) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>(a.size() + (b == null ? 0 : b.size()));\n        m.putAll(a);\n        if (b != null) m.putAll(b);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7c693ab9-72ca-42fd-8b80-1d28f59a9723","session_id":"280ab253-9e58-4fb9-b4f5-07f3763ba205","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp20/b","sessionId":"280ab253-9e58-4fb9-b4f5-07f3763ba205","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp20-b","slug":"keen-spinning-charm"}

Missing metadata and untrusted\n * constraints are always conservative: the join is retained and the reason\n * reported. The rules and proofs are in README.md.\n *\n * <p>Rewrite rules (see README for the formal statements):\n * <ul>\n *   <li><b>E-LEFT</b>: {@code A LEFT JOIN B ON A.fk=B.uk} may be replaced by\n *       {@code A} when no column of {@code B} is used above the join and\n *       {@code B.uk} is a trusted unique key.</li>\n *   <li><b>E-RIGHT</b>: mirror image of E-LEFT.</li>\n *   <li><b>E-INNER</b>: {@code A JOIN B ON A.fk=B.uk} may be replaced by\n *       {@code A} when no column of {@code B} is used above, {@code A.fk} is\n *       trusted NOT NULL, {@code A.fk REFERENCES B.uk} is a trusted foreign\n *       key, and {@code B.uk} is a trusted unique key.</li>\n * </ul>\n * FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN and non-equi joins are never rewritten.\n */\npublic final class Rewriter {\n\n    public enum Policy {\n        /** Only constraints declared \"trusted\" may be used; untrusted => reject. */\n        TRUST_CATALOG,\n        /** Every premise is re-checked against the loaded data; failed => reject. */\n        VALIDATE_ALL\n    }\n\n    public enum Outcome {\n        REMOVED,\n        KEPT,\n        REJECTED_UNTRUSTED,\n        REJECTED_NO_METADATA,\n        REJECTED_VIOLATED,\n        REJECTED_STRUCTURAL,\n        UNSAFE_FORCED\n    }\n\n    public record Premise(String id, String description, boolean satisfied, String detail) {}\n\n    public record Decision(\n            String joinId,\n            String joinType,\n            String rule,\n            String eliminatedSide,\n            Outcome outcome,\n            String reason,\n            List<Premise> premises) {\n\n        public boolean removed() { return outcome == Outcome.REMOVED; }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"joinId\", joinId);\n            m.put(\"joinType\", joinType);\n            m.put(\"rule\", rule);\n            m.put(\"eliminatedSide\", eliminatedSide);\n            m.put(\"outcome\", outcome.name());\n            m.put(\"reason\", reason);\n            m.put(\"premises\", premises.stream().map(p -> {\n                Map<String, Object> pm = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                pm.put(\"id\", p.id());\n                pm.put(\"description\", p.description());\n                pm.put(\"satisfied\", p.satisfied());\n                pm.put(\"detail\", p.detail());\n                return pm;\n            }).toList());\n            return m;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public record RewriteResult(Plan.Node plan, List<Decision> decisions) {\n        public int removedCount() {\n            return (int) decisions.stream().filter(Decision::removed).count();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** One equality pair of the ON clause: colLeft = colRight (resolved keys). */\n    private record EqPair(String leftKey, String rightKey) {}\n\n    private final Catalog cat;\n    private final Checker checker;\n    private final Policy policy;\n    private final boolean forceUnsafe;\n    private final List<Decision> decisions = new ArrayList<>();\n    private int joinSeq = 0;\n\n    public Rewriter(Catalog cat, Policy policy, boolean forceUnsafe) {\n        this.cat = cat;\n        this.checker = new Checker(cat);\n        this.policy = policy;\n        this.forceUnsafe = forceUnsafe;\n    }\n\n    public RewriteResult rewrite(Plan.Node root) {\n        Plan.Node out = go(root, root);\n        return new RewriteResult(out, List.copyOf(decisions));\n    }\n\n    private Plan.Node go(Plan.Node n, Plan.Node root) {\n        return switch (n) {\n            case Plan.Filter f -> new Plan.Filter(go(f.input(), root), f.pred());\n            case Plan.Project p -> new Plan.Project(go(p.input(), root), p.items(), p.distinct());\n            case Plan.Join j -> {\n                Plan.Node newLeft = go(j.left(), root);\n                Plan.Node newRight = go(j.right(), root);\n                Plan.Join rebuilt = new Plan.Join(j.joinType(), newLeft, newRight, j.on());\n                yield analyzeJoin(rebuilt, root);\n            }\n            case Plan.Scan s -> s;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Plan.Node analyzeJoin(Plan.Join j, Plan.Node root) {\n        String id = \"J\" + (++joinSeq);\n\n        if (j.joinType().equals(\"full\"))\n            return keep(j, id, null, Outcome.KEPT, \"FULL OUTER JOIN elimination is not supported (requires bidirectional integrity); retained conservatively\");\n\n        boolean eliminatingRight = switch (j.joinType()) {\n            case \"left\", \"inner\" -> true;\n            case \"right\" -> false;\n            default -> false;\n        };\n        String rule = switch (j.joinType()) {\n            case \"left\" -> \"E-LEFT\";\n            case \"right\" -> \"E-RIGHT\";\n            case \"inner\" -> \"E-INNER\";\n            default -> \"NONE\";\n        };\n        String sideName = eliminatingRight ? \"right\" : \"left\";\n        Plan.Node keptSide = eliminatingRight ? j.left() : j.right();\n        Plan.Node dropSide = eliminatingRight ? j.right() : j.left();\n\n        List<Premise> premises = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        // P1 structural: equi-only ON\n        List<EqPair> pairs = extractEqPairs(j);\n        boolean eqOk = j.on() != null && pairs != null;\n        premises.add(new Premise(\"P1_EQUI_JOIN\",\n                \"ON is a conjunction of plain column equalities, one column from each side\",\n                eqOk, eqOk ? \"AND of \" + (pairs == null ? 0 : pairs.size()) + \" equality atom(s)\"\n                           : j.on() == null ? \"CROSS JOIN (no ON predicate)\"\n                                           : \"ON contains non-equality / non-column predicates or mixed sides\"));\n        if (!eqOk)\n            return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_STRUCTURAL,\n                    \"join predicate is not a pure equi-join; non-equi predicates may filter rows, so elimination is unsafe\",\n                    premises);\n\n        // P2 structural: dropped side is a single base table (metadata lookup needs a relation)\n        if (!(dropSide instanceof Plan.Scan dropScan))\n            return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_STRUCTURAL,\n                    \"the side to eliminate is not a single table scan (v1 supports base-table elimination only)\",\n                    premises);\n        premises.add(new Premise(\"P2_BASE_TABLE\",\n                \"eliminated side is a single base table: \" + dropScan.table(),\n                true, \"scan of \" + dropScan.table() + \" as \" + dropScan.alias()));\n\n        // P3 liveness: no column of the dropped side is used outside the join\n        Set<String> dropAliases = aliases(dropSide);\n        Set<String> externalRefs = externalRefs(root, j);\n        List<String> used = externalRefs.stream()\n                .filter(k -> dropAliases.contains(aliasOf(k))).sorted().toList();\n        boolean unused = used.isEmpty();\n        premises.add(new Premise(\"P3_PROJECTION_UNUSED\",\n                \"no column of the eliminated side is used in projections, filters or other join predicates\",\n                unused, unused ? \"no external reference to \" + dropAliases\n                               : \"referenced externally: \" + used));\n        if (!unused)\n            return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.KEPT,\n                    \"columns of \" + dropScan.table() + \" are still needed: \" + used, premises);\n\n        // align equality pairs so drop-side column is first\n        List<String> dropCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<String> keepCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (EqPair p : pairs) {\n            if (eliminatingRight) { dropCols.add(bare(p.rightKey(), j)); keepCols.add(bare(p.leftKey(), j)); }\n            else { dropCols.add(bare(p.leftKey(), j)); keepCols.add(bare(p.rightKey(), j)); }\n        }\n\n        // P4 unique key on dropped table\n        Catalog.UniqueRef uk = findUnique(dropScan.table(), dropCols);\n        if (uk == null) {\n            premises.add(new Premise(\"P4_UNIQUE_KEY\",\n                    \"join columns on the eliminated table form a unique (or primary) key\",\n                    false, \"no UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY constraint declared on \"\n                            + dropScan.table() + \"(\" + String.join(\",\", dropCols) + \")\"));\n            return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_NO_METADATA,\n                    \"metadata missing: without a unique key a matching row could be duplicated, so the join could multiply rows\",\n                    premises);\n        }\n        Catalog.Constraint uniqueC = uniqueConstraint(uk);\n        boolean uniqueTrusted = uniqueC.trust() == Catalog.Trust.TRUSTED;\n        premises.add(new Premise(\"P4_UNIQUE_KEY\",\n                \"join columns on the eliminated table form a unique key\",\n                true, uniqueC.kind() + \" \" + uniqueC.name() + \" on \" + uk.display()\n                        + \" (trust=\" + uniqueC.trust() + \")\"));\n        if (!uniqueTrusted) {\n            if (forceUnsafe) return forced(j, id, rule, sideName, premises,\n                    \"unique key \" + uniqueC.name() + \" is declared UNTRUSTED\");\n            return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_UNTRUSTED,\n                    \"constraint \" + uniqueC.name() + \" is marked trust=untrusted; an untrusted uniqueness guarantee cannot justify elimination\",\n                    premises);\n        }\n\n        // P5/P6 inner-join-only: NOT NULL + FK on kept side\n        if (j.joinType().equals(\"inner\")) {\n            if (!(keptSide instanceof Plan.Scan keepScan)) {\n                premises.add(new Premise(\"P5_NOT_NULL_FK\",\n                        \"kept side is a single base table with NOT NULL FK\", false,\n                        \"kept side is not a base table; inner-join elimination v1 needs base-table FK metadata\"));\n                return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_STRUCTURAL,\n                        \"inner join kept side is not a single table scan\", premises);\n            }\n            // NOT NULL on each kept-side join column\n            List<Catalog.NotNull> nns = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<String> missingNull = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (String kc : keepCols) {\n                Catalog.NotNull nn = findNotNull(keepScan.table(), kc);\n                if (nn == null) missingNull.add(kc);\n                else nns.add(nn);\n            }\n            if (!missingNull.isEmpty()) {\n                premises.add(new Premise(\"P5_NOT_NULL_FK\",\n                        \"join columns of the kept table are declared NOT NULL\",\n                        false, \"no trusted NOT NULL metadata for: \" + missingNull));\n                return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_NO_METADATA,\n                        \"metadata missing: with NULL join values an inner join drops rows, so it cannot be eliminated without NOT NULL\",\n                        premises);\n            }\n            boolean nnTrusted = nns.stream().allMatch(n -> n.trust() == Catalog.Trust.TRUSTED);\n            premises.add(new Premise(\"P5_NOT_NULL_FK\",\n                    \"join columns of the kept table are NOT NULL\",\n                    true, nns.stream().map(n -> n.name() + \"(trust=\" + n.trust() + \")\").toList().toString()));\n            if (!nnTrusted) {\n                if (forceUnsafe) return forced(j, id, rule, sideName, premises,\n                        \"NOT NULL constraint is UNTRUSTED\");\n                return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_UNTRUSTED,\n                        \"a NOT NULL constraint on \" + keepScan.table() + \" is untrusted\", premises);\n            }\n\n            // FK kept-side -> dropped table unique key\n            Catalog.ForeignKey fk = findFK(keepScan.table(), keepCols, dropScan.table(), dropCols);\n            if (fk == null) {\n                premises.add(new Premise(\"P6_FOREIGN_KEY\",\n                        \"kept table join columns reference the eliminated unique key\",\n                        false, \"no FK \" + keepScan.table() + \"(\" + String.join(\",\", keepCols) + \")->\"\n                                + dropScan.table() + \"(\" + String.join(\",\", dropCols) + \")\"));\n                return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_NO_METADATA,\n                        \"metadata missing: without a foreign key an inner join can drop unmatched rows, so elimination is unsafe\",\n                        premises);\n            }\n            boolean fkTrusted = fk.trust() == Catalog.Trust.TRUSTED;\n            premises.add(new Premise(\"P6_FOREIGN_KEY\",\n                    \"kept rows reference exactly one eliminated row\",\n                    true, \"FK \" + fk.name() + \" (trust=\" + fk.trust() + \")\"));\n            if (!fkTrusted) {\n                if (forceUnsafe) return forced(j, id, rule, sideName, premises,\n                        \"foreign key \" + fk.name() + \" is UNTRUSTED\");\n                return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_UNTRUSTED,\n                        \"foreign key \" + fk.name() + \" is marked trust=untrusted; dangling rows would silently change the result\",\n                        premises);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // data validation under VALIDATE_ALL\n        if (policy == Policy.VALIDATE_ALL) {\n            List<Checker.Violation> vios = new ArrayList<>();\n            vios.addAll(checker.check(uniqueC).violations());\n            if (j.joinType().equals(\"inner\")) {\n                for (Catalog.NotNull nn : cat.allConstraints().stream()\n                        .filter(c -> c instanceof Catalog.NotNull n\n                                && n.table().equals(((Plan.Scan) keptSide).table())\n                                && keepCols.contains(n.column()))\n                        .map(c -> (Catalog.NotNull) c).toList())\n                    vios.addAll(checker.check(nn).violations());\n                Catalog.ForeignKey fk = findFK(((Plan.Scan) keptSide).table(), keepCols,\n                        dropScan.table(), dropCols);\n                if (fk != null) vios.addAll(checker.check(fk).violations());\n            }\n            if (!vios.isEmpty()) {\n                premises.add(new Premise(\"P7_DATA_VALIDATED\",\n                        \"declared constraints verified against the loaded data\",\n                        false, vios.get(0).detail()));\n                return reject(j, id, rule, sideName, Outcome.REJECTED_VIOLATED,\n                        \"constraint violated by the data: \" + vios.get(0).detail()\n                                + \" — example row \" + Json.write(vios.get(0).exampleRow()),\n                        premises);\n            }\n            premises.add(new Premise(\"P7_DATA_VALIDATED\",\n                    \"declared constraints verified against the loaded data\",\n                    true, \"all premise constraints validated\"));\n        }\n\n        decisions.add(new Decision(id, j.joinType(), rule, sideName, Outcome.REMOVED,\n                \"all premises satisfied; join provably redundant\", List.copyOf(premises)));\n        return keptSide;\n    }\n\n    private Plan.Node reject(Plan.Join j, String id, String rule, String side,\n                             Outcome outcome, String reason, List<Premise> premises) {\n        decisions.add(new Decision(id, j.joinType(), rule, side, outcome, reason, List.copyOf(premises)));\n        return j;\n    }\n\n    private Plan.Node forced(Plan.Join j, String id, String rule, String side,\n                             List<Premise> premises, String warning) {\n        decisions.add(new Decision(id, j.joinType(), rule, side, Outcome.UNSAFE_FORCED,\n                \"forceUnsafeRewrite=true: metadata/trust premises IGNORED (\" + warning\n                        + \"); the rewritten plan is NOT guaranteed equivalent\",\n                List.copyOf(premises)));\n        return switch (j.joinType()) {\n            case \"left\" -> j.left();\n            case \"right\" -> j.right();\n            default -> j.joinType().equals(\"inner\") ? j.left() : j;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Plan.Node keep(Plan.Join j, String id, String side, Outcome outcome, String reason) {\n        decisions.add(new Decision(id, j.joinType(), \"NONE\", side == null ? \"\" : side,\n                outcome, reason, List.of()));\n        return j;\n    }\n\n    /** @return equality pairs in left-key/right-key order, or null if ON is not a pure equi-conjunction. */\n    private List<EqPair> extractEqPairs(Plan.Join j) {\n        List<Plan.Expr> atoms = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (!flattenAnd(j.on(), atoms)) return null;\n        List<EqPair> pairs = new ArrayList<>();\n        Set<String> leftAliases = aliases(j.left());\n        Set<String> rightAliases = aliases(j.right());\n        for (Plan.Expr a : atoms) {\n            if (!(a instanceof Plan.Cmp c) || !c.op().equals(\"=\")) return null;\n            if (!(c.left() instanceof Plan.Col l) || !(c.right() instanceof Plan.Col r)) return null;\n            boolean lL = leftAliases.contains(aliasOf(l.key()));\n            boolean lR = rightAliases.contains(aliasOf(l.key()));\n            boolean rL = leftAliases.contains(aliasOf(r.key()));\n            boolean rR = rightAliases.contains(aliasOf(r.key()));\n            if (lL && rR) pairs.add(new EqPair(l.key(), r.key()));\n            else if (lR && rL) pairs.add(new EqPair(r.key(), l.key()));\n            else public enum Policy {\n        /** Only constraints declared \"trusted\" may be used; untrusted => reject. */\n        TRUST_CATALOG,\n        /** Every premise is re-checked against the loaded data; REJECTED_VIOLATED,\n        REJECTED_STRUCTURAL,\n        UNSAFE_FORCED\n    }\n\n    public record Premise(String id, String description, boolean satisfied, String detail) {}\n\n    public record column\n            List<Catalog.NotNull> nns = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<String> missingNull = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (String kc : keepCols) {\n                Catalog.NotNull nn = findNotNull(keepScan.table(), kc);\n                if (nn == null) missingNull.add(kc);\n                else nns.add(nn);\n            }\n            if (!missingNull.isEmpty()) {\n private List<EqPair> extractEqPairs(Plan.Join j) {\n        List<Plan.Expr> atoms = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (!flattenAnd(j.on(), atoms)) return null;\n        List<EqPair> pairs = new Plan.Cmp c) || !c.op().equals(\"=\")) return null;\n            if (!(c.left() instanceof Plan.Col l) || !(c.right() instanceof Plan.Col r)) return null;\n            boolean lL = leftAliases.contains(aliasOf(l.key()));\n            boolean lR = rightAliases.contains(aliasOf(l.key()));\n            boolean rL = leftAliases.contains(aliasOf(r.key()));\n            boolean rR = rightAliases.contains(aliasOf(r.key()));\n            if (lL && rR) pairs.add(new EqPair(l.key(), r.key()));\n            else if (lR && rL) pairs.add(new EqPair(r.key(), l.key()));\n            else true;\n            }\n            case Plan.Cmp c -> c.op().equals(\"=\") && (out.add(e) || true);\n            default -> false;\n        };\n    }\n\n    /** Column references used outside the given oj;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * Request orchestration: builds the catalog, resolves and rewrites the plan,\n * executes the original and rewritten plans, and proves equivalence (or\n * demonstrates the discrepancy for an unsafe forced rewrite).\n */\npublic final class Engine {\n\n    public record Options(Rewriter.Policy policy, boolean forceUnsafe) {}\n\n    public static Catalog buildCatalog(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        Catalog cat = new Catalog();\n        for (Object t : Json.arr(req.getOrDefault(\"tables\", List.of()), \"tables\"))\n            cat.load(Json.obj(t, \"tables[]\"));\n        for (Object co : Json.arr(req.getOrDefault(\"constraints\", List.of()), \"constraints\")) {\n            Map<String, Object> m = Json.obj(co, \"constraints[]\");\n            String type = Json.str(m.get(\"type\"), \"constraints[].type\").toLowerCase();\n            if (type.equals(\"foreign key\") || type.equals(\"foreignkey\") || m.containsKey(\"references\"))\n                cat.parseForeignKey(m);\n            else\n                cat.parseConstraint(m);\n        }\n        return cat;\n    }\n\n    public static Options options(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        Map<String, Object> opts = Json.optObj(req, \"options\");\n        String policy = opts == null ? \"trust_catalog\"\n                : Json.optStr(opts, \"policy\", \"trust_catalog\");\n        Rewriter.Policy p = switch (policy.toLowerCase()) {\n            case \"trust_catalog\", \"trusted\" -> Rewriter.Policy.TRUST_CATALOG;\n            case \"validate_all\", \"validate\" -> Rewriter.Policy.VALIDATE_ALL;\n            default -> throw new Json.JException(\"unknown options.policy: \" + policy);\n        };\n        boolean force = opts != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(opts.get(\"forceUnsafeRewrite\"));\n        return new Options(p, force);\n    }\n\n    /** Handle a full request envelope. */\n    public static Map<String, Object> handle(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        String action = Json.optStr(req, \"action\", \"query\");\n        Catalog cat = buildCatalog(req);\n        return switch (action) {\n            case \"query\", \"explain\" -> query(req, cat, action.equals(\"explain\"));\n            case \"validate\" -> validate(cat);\n            case \"catalog\" -> catalogView(cat);\n            default -> throw new Json.JException(\"unknown action: \" + action);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> query(Map<String, Object> req, Catalog cat, boolean explain) {\n        Options opt = options(req);\n        Plan.Node raw = Plan.parseNode(req.get(\"plan\"));\n        Plan.Node original = Plan.resolve(raw, cat);\n\n        Rewriter rw = new Rewriter(cat, opt.policy(), opt.forceUnsafe());\n        Rewriter.RewriteResult rr = rw.rewrite(original);\n\n        Executor exec = new Executor(cat);\n        Executor.Result a = exec.execute(original);\n        Executor.Result b = exec.execute(rr.plan());\n        boolean equivalent = multisetEquals(a, b);\n\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", true);\n        resp.put(\"policy\", opt.policy().name());\n        resp.put(\"planOriginal\", original.toJson());\n        resp.put(\"planRewritten\", rr.plan().toJson());\n        resp.put(\"decisions\", rr.decisions().stream().map(Rewriter.Decision::toJson).toList());\n        resp.put(\"joinsRemoved\", rr.removedCount());\n        resp.put(\"equivalence\", equivalenceJson(a, b, equivalent));\n        if (!explain) {\n            resp.put(\"result\", resultJson(b));\n        }\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> validate(Catalog cat) {\n        Checker ch = new Checker(cat);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();\n        boolean allHold = true;\n        for (Catalog.Constraint c : cat.allConstraints()) {\n            Checker.Result r = ch.check(c);\n            if (!r.holds()) allHold = false;\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"name\", c.name());\n            m.put(\"kind\", c.kind());\n            m.put(\"table\", c.table());\n            m.put(\"trust\", c.trust().name());\n            m.put(\"holds\", r.holds());\n            m.put(\"violations\", r.violations().stream().map(v -> {\n                Map<String, Object> vm = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                vm.put(\"detail\", v.detail());\n                vm.put(\"exampleRow\", v.exampleRow());\n                return vm;\n            }).toList());\n            items.add(m);\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", true);\n        resp.put(\"allHold\", allHold);\n        resp.put(\"constraints\", items);\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> catalogView(Catalog cat) {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", true);\n        resp.put(\"tables\", cat.allConstraints()); // placeholder replaced below\n        List<Map<String, Object>> tables = new ArrayList<>();\n        // rebuild table list from catalog rows via reflection-light access:\n        for (String name : tableNames(cat)) {\n            Catalog.Table t = cat.table(name);\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"name\", t.name);\n            m.put(\"columns\", t.columns);\n            m.put(\"rowCount\", t.rows.size());\n            tables.add(m);\n        }\n        resp.put(\"tables\", tables);\n        resp.put(\"constraints\", cat.allConstraints().stream().map(c -> {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"name\", c.name());\n            m.put(\"kind\", c.kind());\n            m.put(\"table\", c.table());\n            m.put(\"trust\", c.trust().name());\n            return m;\n        }).toList());\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> tableNames(Catalog cat) {\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        // Catalog exposes lookup by known names; gather through validate-less parse not possible,\n        // so use the constraints + a simple internal accessor.\n        for (Catalog.Table t : cat.tables()) names.add(t.name);\n        return names;\n    }\n\n    static Map<String, Object> resultJson(Executor.Result r) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"columns\", r.columns());\n        m.put(\"rowCount\", r.rowCount());\n        m.put(\"rows\", r.rows());\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> equivalenceJson(Executor.Result a, Executor.Result b, boolean eq) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"proven\", eq);\n        m.put(\"originalRowCount\", a.rowCount());\n        m.put(\"rewrittenRowCount\", b.rowCount());\n        if (!eq) m.put(\"counterexample\", counterexample(a, b));\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    /** Multiset (bag) equality of the two result sets, over aligned columns. */\n    static boolean multisetEquals(Executor.Result a, Executor.Result b) {\n        if (!a.columns().equals(b.columns())) return false;\n        java.util.Map<List<Object>, Integer> counts = new java.util.HashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : a.rows()) {\n            List<Object> key = key(row, a.columns());\n            counts.merge(key, 1, Integer::sum);\n        }\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : b.rows()) {\n            List<Object> key = key(row, b.columns());\n            Integer n = counts.get(key);\n            if (n == null) return false;\n            if (n == 1) counts.remove(key); else counts.put(key, n - 1);\n        }\n        return counts.isEmpty();\n    }\n\n    private static List<Object> key(Map<String, Object> row, List<String> cols) {\n        List<Object> k = new ArrayList<>(cols.size());\n        for (String c : cols) k.add(Value.key(row.get(c)));\n        return k;\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> counterexample(Executor.Result a, Executor.Result b) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"columnsMatched\", a.columns().equals(b.columns()));\n        // up to 3 rows present in one bag but not the other\n        m.put(\"onlyInOriginal\", diffRows(a, b, 3));\n        m.put(\"onlyInRewritten\", diffRows(b, a, 3));\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static List<Map<String, Object>> diffRows(Executor.Result x, Executor.Result y, int limit) {\n        if (!x.columns().equals(y.columns())) return List.of();\n        java.util.Map<List<Object>, Integer> ys = new java.util.HashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : y.rows()) ys.merge(key(row, y.columns()), 1, Integer::sum);\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : x.rows()) {\n            List<Object> k = key(row, x.columns());\n            Integer n = ys.get(k);\n            if (n == null) { out.add(row); if (out.size() >= limit) break; }\n            else if (n == 1) ys.remove(k); else ys.put(k, n - 1);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_0e53757b01e86cf3f287987f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1158,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":64312,"output_tokens":2385,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_6qe7ecnee595d40xu1c4ke2i":{"content":"package The rewriter must never rely on it.\n         */\n        UNTRUSTED;\n\n        static Trust fromString(String s) {\n            if (s == null || s.isBlank()) return UNTRUSTED; // missing metadata => conservative\n            return switch (s.toLowerCase()) {\n                case \"trusted\" -> TRUSTED;\n                case \"untrusted\" -> UNTRUSTED;\n                default -> throw new Json.JException(\"constraints.trust must be 'trusted' or 'untrusted', got '\" + s + \"'\");\n            };\n        }\n    }\n\n    public record UniqueRef(String table, List<String> columns) {\n        public String display() { return table + \"(\" + String.join(\",\", columns) + \")\"; }\n    }\n\n    public sealed interface Constraint permits Unique, PrimaryKey, NotNull, ForeignKey {\n        String name();\n        String table();\n        Trust trust();\n        String kind();\n    }\n\n    public record Unique(String name, String table, List<String> columns, Trust trust)\n            implements Constraint {\n        public String kind() { return \"UNIQUE\"; }\n    }\n\n    public record PrimaryKey(String name, String table, List<String> columns, Trust trust)\n            implements Constraint {\n        public String kind() { return \"PRIMARY KEY\"; }\n    }\n\n    public record NotNull(String name, String table, String column, Trust trust)\n            implements Constraint {\n        public String kind() { return \"NOT NULL\"; }\n    }\n\n    public record ForeignKey(String name, String table, List<String> columns,\n                             String refTable, List<String> refColumns, Trust trust)\n            implements Constraint {\n        public String kind() { return \"FOREIGN KEY\"; }\n    }\n\n    public static final class Table {\n        public final String name;\n        public final List<String> columns;\n        public final List<Map<String, Object>> rows;\n\n        Table(String name, List<String> columns, List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {\n            this.name = name;\n            this.columns = columns;\n            this.rows = rows;\n        }\n\n        public String canon(String col) { return name + \".\" + col; }\n    }\n\n    private final Map<String, Table> tables = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n    private final List<Constraint> constraints = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    // ---------- loading ----------\n\n    public void load(Map<String, Object> tableJson) {\n        String name = Json.str(tableJson.get(\"name\"), \"tables[].name\");\n        if (tables.containsKey(name))\n            throw new Json.JException(\"duplicate table: \" + name);\n        List<String> cols = Json.strList(tableJson.get(\"columns\"), \"tables[\" + name + \"].columns\");\n        if (cols.isEmpty()) throw new Json.JException(\"table \" + name + \" has no columns\");\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object ro : Json.arr(tableJson.getOrDefault(\"rows\", List.of()), \"tables[\" + name + \"].rows\")) {\n            Map<String, Object> raw = Json.obj(ro, \"tables[\" + name + \"].rows[]\");\n            Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (String c : cols) {\n                if (!raw.containsKey(c))\n                    throw new Json.JException(\"table \" + name + \": row missing column '\" + c + \"'\");\n                row.put(name + \".\" + c, raw.get(c));\n            }\n            if (raw.size() != cols.size()) {\n                for (String k : raw.keySet())\n                    if (!cols.contains(k))\n                        throw new Json.JException(\"table \" + name + \": unknown column in row: \" + k);\n            }\n            rows.add(row);\n        }\n        tables.put(name, new Table(name, List.copyOf(cols), rows));\n    }\n\n    public void addConstraint(Constraint c) { constraints.add(c); }\n\n    public Table table(String name) {\n        Table t = tables.get(name);\n        if (t == null) throw new Json.JException(\"unknown table: \" + name);\n        return t;\n    }\n\n    public boolean hasTable(String name) { return tables.containsKey(name); }\n\n    public List<Constraint> constraintsOn(String table) {\n        List<Constraint> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Constraint c : constraints) if (c.table().equals(table)) out.add(c);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    public List<Constraint> allConstraints() { return constraints; }\n\n    /** Re-key a table's rows from {@code table.col} to {@code alias.col}. */\n    public List<Map<String, Object>> bind(Table t, String alias) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(t.rows.size());\n        for (Map<String, Object> r : t.rows) {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> e : r.entrySet()) {\n                String col = e.getKey().substring(t.name.length() + 1);\n                m.put(alias + \".\" + col, e.getValue());\n            }\n            out.add(m);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    // ---------- constraint parsing ----------\n\n    public void parseConstraint(Map<String, Object> co) {\n        String kind = Json.str(co.get(\"type\"), \"constraints[].type\").toUpperCase();\n        String table = Json.str(co.get(\"table\"), \"constraints[\" + kind + \"].table\");\n        String cname = Json.optStr(co, \"name\", kind.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '_') + \"_\"\n                + table + \"_\" + String.join(\"_\", Json.strList(\n                        co.getOrDefault(\"columns\", co.get(\"column\") == null ? List.of() : List.of(co.get(\"column\"))),\n                        \"constraints.columns\")));\n        Trust trust = Trust.fromString(Json.optStr(co, \"trust\", \"untrusted\"));\n        switch (kind) {\n            case \"UNIQUE\" -> constraints.add(new Unique(cname, table,\n                    Json.strList(co.get(\"columns\"), \"constraints.columns\"), trust));\n            case \"PRIMARY KEY\", \"PRIMARYKEY\" -> constraints.add(new PrimaryKey(cname, table,\n                    Json.strList(co.get(\"columns\"), \"constraints.columns\"), trust));\n            case \"NOT NULL\", \"NOTNULL\" -> constraints.add(new NotNull(cname, table,\n                    Json.str(co.get(\"column\"), \"constraints.column\"), trust));\n            default -> throw new Json.JException(\"unknown constraint type: \" + kind);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void parseForeignKey(Map<String, Object> co) {\n        String table = Json.str(co.get(\"table\"), \"constraints[foreign_key].table\");\n        List<String> cols = Json.strList(co.get(\"columns\"), \"constraints.columns\");\n        Map<String, Object> ref = Json.obj(co.get(\"references\"), \"constraints.references\");\n        String refTable = Json.str(ref.get(\"table\"), \"constraints.references.table\");\n        List<String> refCols = Json.strList(ref.get(\"columns\"), \"constraints.references.columns\");\n        if (cols.size() != refCols.size())\n            throw new Json.JException(\"foreign key on \" + table + \": column count mismatch\");\n        String cname = Json.optStr(co, \"name\", \"fk_\" + table + \"_\" + refTable);\n        Trust trust = Trust.fromString(Json.optStr(co, \"trust\", \"untrusted\"));\n        constraints.add(new ForeignKey(cname, table, cols, refTable, refCols, trust));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":121,"oldLines":6,"newStart":121,"newLines":8,"lines":[" ","     public boolean hasTable(String name) { return tables.containsKey(name); options(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        Map<String, Object> opts = Json.optObj(req, \"options\");\n        String policy = opts == null ? \"trust_catalog\"\n                : Json.optStr(opts, \"policy\", \"trust_catalog\");\n        Rewriter.Policy p = switch (policy.toLowerCase()) {\n            case \"trust_catalog\", \"trusted\" -> Rewriter.Policy.TRUST_CATALOG;\n            case {"parentUuid":"e9987ee7-38c5-4394-be3f-d38f55266cc5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_4paizmlvp561ujud2lpw4344","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp20/b/src/ojtest/Harness.java","content":"package ojtest;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.function.Supplier;\n\n/** Tiny zero-dependency test harness. */\npublic final class Harness {\n\n    public record Case(String name, Supplier<Void> body) {}\n\n    private static final List<Case> CASES = new ArrayList<>();\n    private static int passed = 0;\n    private static final List<String> failures = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public static void test(String name, Runnable r) {\n        CASES.add(new Case(name, () -> { r.run(); return null; }));\n    }\n\n    public static void check(boolean cond, String msg) {\n        if (!cond) throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n\n    public static void eq(Object actual, Object expected, String msg) {\n        if (!java.util.Objects.equals(actual, expected))\n            throw new AssertionError(msg + \" — expected <\" + expected + \"> but got <\" + actual + \">\");\n    }\n\n    public static int run() {\n        for (Case c : CASES) {\n            try {\n                c.body().get();\n                passed++;\n                System.out.println(\"PASS \" + c.name());\n            } catch (Throwable t) {\n                failures.add(c.name());\n                System.out.println(\"FAIL \" + c.name() + \" : \" + t.getMessage());\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"-\".repeat(60));\n        System.out.println(passed + \"/\" + CASES.size() + \" passed\");\n        if (!failures.isEmpty()) {\n            System.out.println(\"FAILED: \" + failures);\n            return 1;\n        }\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> response(String json) {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = oj.Engine.handle(oj.Json.parseObject(json));\n        if (Boolean.FALSE.equals(resp.get(\"ok\")))\n            throw new AssertionError(\"request failed: \" + resp.get(\"message\"));\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> resp(String json) { return response(json); }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static List<Map<String, Object>> decisions(Map<String, Object> resp) {\n        return (List<Map<String, Object>>) resp.get(\"decisions\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static Map<String, Object> equivalence(Map<String, Object> resp) {\n        return (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"equivalence\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7c552382486824563612878f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":605,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":1184,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_4paizmlvp561ujud2lpw4344":{"content":"package ojtest;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.function.Supplier;\n\n/** Tiny zero-dependency test harness. */\npublic final class Harness {\n\n    public record Case(String name, Supplier<Void> body) {}\n\n    private static final List<Case> CASES = new ArrayList<>();\n    private static int passed = 0;\n    private static final List<String> failures = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public static void test(String name, Runnable r) {\n        CASES.add(new Case(name, () -> { r.run(); ojtest;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * Acceptance tests for constrained outer-join elimination.\n *\n * Scenario (classical): orders LEFT JOIN customers.\n * customers.id is unique; orders.cid references it.\n */\npublic final class Tests {\n\n    // ---------------- fixtures ----------------\n\n    /** Standard satisfying dataset; cid=7 in orders has no matching customer. */\n    static String GOOD_TABLES = \"\"\"\n      \"tables\": [\n        {\"name\":\"customers\",\"columns\":[\"id\",\"name\"],\"rows\":[\n          {\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Ada\"},\n          {\"id\":2,\"name\":\"Bob\"}\n        ]},\n        {\"name\":\"orders\",\"columns\":[\"oid\",\"cid\",\"amount\"],\"rows\":[\n          {\"oid\":10,\"cid\":1,\"amount\":100},\n          {\"oid\":11,\"cid\":2,\"amount\":200},\n          {\"oid\":12,\"cid\":7,\"amount\":300}\n        ]}\n      ]\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String TRUSTED_CONSTRAINTS = \"\"\"\n      \"constraints\": [\n        {\"type\":\"primary key\",\"table\":\"customers\",\"columns\":[\"id\"],\"trust\":\"trusted\",\"name\":\"pk_cust\"},\n        {\"type\":\"not null\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"column\":\"oid\",\"trust\":\"trusted\",\"name\":\"nn_oid\"},\n        {\"type\":\"foreign key\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"columns\":[\"cid\"],\n         \"references\":{\"table\":\"customers\",\"columns\":[\"id\"]},\"trust\":\"trusted\",\"name\":\"fk_cid\"}\n      ]\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String UNTRUSTED_PK = TRUSTED_CONSTRAINTS.replace(\n            \"\\\"type\\\":\\\"primary key\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"customers\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"trust\\\":\\\"trusted\\\"\",\n            \"\\\"type\\\":\\\"primary key\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"customers\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"trust\\\":\\\"untrusted\\\"\");\n\n    static String NO_CONSTRAINTS = \"\\\"constraints\\\": []\";\n\n    /** customers with a duplicated id=2 — violates the primary key. */\n    static String DUP_TABLES = GOOD_TABLES.replace(\n            \"{\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"name\\\":\\\"Bob\\\"}\",\n            \"{\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"name\\\":\\\"Bob\\\"},\\n          {\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"name\\\":\\\"Bob2\\\"}\");\n\n    /** orders with a cid that has no matching customer AND is not null. */\n    static String DANGLING_TABLES = GOOD_TABLES.replace(\n            \"{\\\"oid\\\":12,\\\"cid\\\":7,\\\"amount\\\":300}\",\n            \"{\\\"oid\\\":12,\\\"cid\\\":9,\\\"amount\\\":300}\");\n\n    /** orders.cid contains a NULL (legal under the nullable FK column). */\n    static String NULLCID_TABLES = GOOD_TABLES.replace(\n            \"{\\\"oid\\\":12,\\\"cid\\\":7,\\\"amount\\\":300}\",\n            \"{\\\"oid\\\":12,\\\"cid\\\":null,\\\"amount\\\":300}\");\n\n    static String LEFT_JOIN_ORDERS_ONLY = \"\"\"\n      \"plan\": {\n        \"node\":\"project\",\n        \"cols\":[\"o.oid\",\"o.amount\"],\n        \"input\":{\"node\":\"join\",\"type\":\"left\",\n          \"left\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"alias\":\"o\"},\n          \"right\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"customers\",\"alias\":\"c\"},\n          \"on\":{\"cmp\":\"=\",\"left\":\"o.cid\",\"right\":\"c.id\"}}\n      }\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String LEFT_JOIN_WITH_NAME = LEFT_JOIN_ORDERS_ONLY.replace(\n            \"\\\"cols\\\":[\\\"o.oid\\\",\\\"o.amount\\\"]\", \"\\\"cols\\\":[\\\"o.oid\\\",\\\"c.name\\\"]\");\n\n    static String INNER_JOIN_ORDERS_ONLY = LEFT_JOIN_ORDERS_ONLY.replace(\n            \"\\\"type\\\":\\\"left\\\"\", \"\\\"type\\\":\\\"inner\\\"\");\n\n    static String RIGHT_JOIN_ORDERS_ONLY = \"\"\"\n      \"plan\": {\n        \"node\":\"project\",\n        \"cols\":[\"o.oid\",\"o.amount\"],\n        \"input\":{\"node\":\"join\",\"type\":\"right\",\n          \"left\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"customers\",\"alias\":\"c\"},\n          \"right\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"alias\":\"o\"},\n          \"on\":{\"cmp\":\"=\",\"left\":\"c.id\",\"right\":\"o.cid\"}}\n      }\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String NON_EQUI = \"\"\"\n      \"plan\": {\n        \"node\":\"project\",\n        \"cols\":[\"o.oid\",\"o.amount\"],\n        \"input\":{\"node\":\"join\",\"type\":\"left\",\n          \"left\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"alias\":\"o\"},\n          \"right\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"customers\",\"alias\":\"c\"},\n          \"on\":{\"cmp\":\">\",\"left\":\"o.cid\",\"right\":\"c.id\"}}\n      }\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String FILTER_USES_CUSTOMER = \"\"\"\n      \"plan\": {\n        \"node\":\"project\",\n        \"cols\":[\"o.oid\",\"o.amount\"],\n        \"input\":{\"node\":\"filter\",\n          \"pred\":{\"cmp\":\"=\",\"left\":\"c.name\",\"right\":{\"lit\":\"Ada\"}},\n          \"input\":{\"node\":\"join\",\"type\":\"left\",\n null\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"column\":\"oid\",\"trust\":\"trusted\",\"name\":\"nn_oid\"},\n        {\"type\":\"foreign key\",\"table\":\"orders\",\"columns\":[\"cid\"],\n         \"references\":{\"table\":\"customers\",\"columns\":[\"id\"]},\"trust\":\"trusted\",\"name\":\"fk_cid\"}\n      ]\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String UNTRUSTED_PK = TRUSTED_CONSTRAINTS.replace(\n key\\\",\\\"table\\\":\\\"customers\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"trust\\\":\\\"untrusted\\\"\");\n\n    static String NO_CONSTRAINTS = \"\\\"constraints\\\": []\";\n\n    /** customers with a \"{\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"name\\\":\\\"Bob\\\"},\\n          {\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"name\\\":\\\"Bob2\\\"}\");\n\n    /** orders with a cid that has no matching customer AND is not null. */\n    static String DANGLING_TABLES = GOOD_TABLES.replace(\n            \"{\\\"oid\\\":12,\\\"cid\\\":7,\\\"amount\\\":300}\",\n            \"{\\\"oid\\\":12,\\\"cid\\\":9,\\\"amount\\\":300}\");\n\n    /** orders.cid \"right\":{\"node\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"customers\",\"alias\":\"c\"},\n          \"on\":{\"cmp\":\"=\",\"left\":\"o.cid\",\"right\":\"c.id\"}}\n      }\n    \"\"\";\n\n    static String LEFT_JOIN_WITH_NAME = LEFT_JOIN_ORDERS_ONLY.replace(\n            \"\\\"cols\\\":[\\\"o.oid\\\",\\\"o.amount\\\"]\", \"\\\"cols\\\":[\\\"o.oid\\\",\\\"c.name\\\"]\");\n\n    static String {"parentUuid":"d54f0555-52da-4deb-8c6a-25a59528da89","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_qm58rfof19wjrf2ei7khk4ky","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp20/b/README.md","content":"# 外连接消除证明（Outer Join Elimination, Prover）\n\n一个**纯后端、零依赖**的单机内存查询引擎与查询计划改写器，用 Java 实现。\n核心计算（扫描、过滤、投影、去重、内/左/右/全外连接）全部手写，**不调用任何现成 SQL 引擎**。\n系统根据**唯一键、非空、外键**三类元数据，判断“投影未使用的连接”能否被安全删除；\n元数据缺失或不可信时**保守保留**连接并输出拒绝原因。每次改写后都会执行原计划与改写计划，\n以**多重集（bag）比对**给出等价性证明（或在强制不安全改写时给出反例）。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 它做什么\n\n给定 JSON 形式的关系代数计划，例如\n\n```\nπ o.oid, o.amount ( orders o  LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.cid = c.id )\n```\n\n当 `customers.id` 是**可信的唯一键**，且投影/过滤/其它连接都不再使用 `customers` 的列时，\n该 LEFT JOIN 可被证明是冗余的，计划改写为 `π o.oid, o.amount ( orders o )`。\n\n响应中包含：原始计划、改写后计划、每个连接的**判定与逐条前提（premises）**、\n两个计划的执行结果、以及多重集等价性证明（行数与反例行）。数据与计划均可导出（见 §8）。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 目录结构\n\n```\nb/\n├── src/oj/                 引擎源码（包 oj）\n│   ├── Main.java           入口：run（文件/标准输入）、serve（HTTP JSON API）\n│   ├── Json.java           手写 JSON 解析/序列化（无外部依赖）\n│   ├── Value.java          标量与 SQL 三值逻辑（NULL 语义）\n│   ├── Catalog.java        表、数据、约束元数据（UNIQUE/PK/NOT NULL/FK + trust）\n│   ├── Plan.java           关系代数节点 + 标量表达式 + 名字解析\n│   ├── Executor.java       Volcano 风格内存执行器（手写全部算子）\n│   ├── Checker.java        用实际数据校验约束（唯一/非空/外键）\n│   ├── Rewriter.java       受限计划改写：E-LEFT / E-RIGHT / E-INNER + 判定理由\n│   └── Engine.java         请求编排、双计划执行、多重集等价证明\n├── src/ojtest/             自动化测试（零依赖断言框架）\n│   ├── Harness.java\n│   └── Tests.java          16 个验收用例\n├── samples/                请求样例（可直接运行）\n│   ├── 01_left_join_safe.json\n│   ├── 02_left_join_used.json\n│   ├── 03_left_join_untrusted.json\n│   ├── 04_left_join_no_metadata.json\n│   ├── 05_left_join_violated_validate.json\n│   ├── 06_inner_join_safe.json\n│   └── 07_validate_action.json\n├── build.sh                javac 编译到 out/\n├── run_tests.sh            编译并运行测试\n└── README.md\n```\n\n环境：实测 **OpenJDK 21**（仅用 JDK 自带 API，`com.sun.net.httpserver` 用于 HTTP 入口）。\n无 Maven/Gradle、无第三方 jar。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\n# 编译（生成 out/）\n./build.sh\n\n# 运行全部自动化测试\n./run_tests.sh\n\n# 处理一个请求文件，结果打印到 stdout\njava -cp out oj.Main run samples/01_left_join_safe.json\n\n# 从标准输入读取\ncat samples/01_left_join_safe.json | java -cp out oj.Main run -\n\n# HTTP JSON 接口（默认 8080，可传端口）\njava -cp out oj.Main serve 8080\ncurl -s localhost:8080/ -d @samples/01_left_join_safe.json\n```\n\n`action` 取值：`query`（默认，执行并返回结果）、`explain`（不返回结果数据，只给计划与判定）、\n`validate`（校验全部约束）、`catalog`（导出表/约束元数据）。\n\n---\n\n## 4. JSON 请求格式\n\n顶层字段：\n\n| 字段 | 说明 |\n|---|---|\n| `action` | `query` / `explain` / `validate` / `catalog` |\n| `tables[]` | `{name, columns[], rows[]}`；行是列名→值的对象，值可为 null |\n| `constraints[]` | 见下；每条带 `trust: \"trusted\" \\| \"untrusted\"`，**缺省视为 untrusted** |\n| `plan` | 关系代数树（query/explain 必填） |\n| `options.policy` | `trust_catalog`（默认）或 `validate_all` |\n| `options.forceUnsafeRewrite` | 调试开关：忽略信任前提强行改写（结果标记为 `UNSAFE_FORCED`，等价性证明会抓出错误） |\n\n约束类型：\n\n```json\n{ \"type\": \"primary key\", \"table\": \"customers\", \"columns\": [\"id\"], \"trust\": \"trusted\" }\n{ \"type\": \"unique\", \"table\": \"p\", \"columns\": [\"a\",\"b\"], \"trust\": \"trusted\" }\n{ \"type\": \"not null\", \"table\": \"orders\", \"column\": \"cid\", \"trust\": \"trusted\" }\n{ \"type\": \"foreign key\", \"table\": \"orders\", \"columns\": [\"cid\"],\n  \"references\": { \"table\": \"customers\", \"columns\": [\"id\"] }, \"trust\": \"trusted\" }\n```\n\n计划节点：\n\n```jsonc\n{ \"node\": \"scan\",    \"table\": \"orders\", \"alias\": \"o\" }\n{ \"node\": \"filter\",  \"input\": <node>, \"pred\": <expr> }\n{ \"node\": \"project\", \"input\": <node>, \"cols\": [\"o.oid\", {\"expr\": <expr>, \"as\": \"x\"}], \"distinct\": false }\n{ \"node\": \"join\",    \"type\": \"inner|left|right|full\",\n  \"left\": <node>, \"right\": <node>, \"on\": <expr> }\n```\n\n表达式：列引用 `\"o.cid\"`；字面量 `{\"lit\": 123}` / `{\"lit\": null}`；\n布尔 `{\"and\":[...]}`、`{\"or\":[...]}`、`{\"not\": e}`；\n比较 `{\"cmp\":\"=\",\"left\": e,\"right\": e}`，运算符 `= != <> < <= > >= isnull isnotnull`。\n连接条件支持等值合取（复合键），如 `{\"and\":[ o.pa=p.a, o.pb=p.b ]}`。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 改写规则与形式化“证明”\n\n下面用多重集（bag，SQL 的默认计数语义）描述；`⊥` 表示补空列。`π` 是最终投影，\n其输出列**全部来自保留侧 R**（“投影未使用连接”即 P3 活性条件）。\n\n### 5.1 引理（唯一性 ⇒ 至多一次匹配）\n\n设 `S.b` 为 UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY。对任意值 k，\n\n```\nσ_{b=k}(S) 至多有一个元组。\n```\n\n对 R 中任一行 r，LEFT JOIN 的匹配数 `m(r) = |σ_{b=r.a}(S)|`（NULL 不参与等值匹配），\n故 **m(r) ≤ 1**。唯一键是该引理成立的唯一必要前提。\n\n### 5.2 规则 E-LEFT（消除 LEFT JOIN 的右表）\n\n计划：`π_R ( R LEFT JOIN S ON R.a = S.b )`。\n\n前提：\n\n- **P1** ON 是纯等值合取，每个等值两侧分属连接两边；\n- **P2** 被消除侧是单个基表扫描 S；\n- **P3** S 的任何列都不被连接之外的算子（上层投影、过滤、其它 ON）使用；\n- **P4** `S.b` 有**可信** UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY 约束。\n\n证明。考察任意 r ∈ R 在左外连接中的贡献：\n\n- m(r)=1：贡献一行 r⊕s，在 R 列上投影得 π(r)；\n- m(r)=0：左外连接补一行 r⊕⊥，在 R 列上投影仍得 π(r)。\n\n两种情况都恰产生一个 π(r)，故\n\n```\nπ_R ( R ⟕_{a=b} S )  ≡  π_R ( R )      （多重集相等）\n```\n\n注意：**E-LEFT 不需要外键、也不需要 R.a 非空**——未匹配行由外连接补空而非被丢弃，\n这正是“外连接”可安全消除而内连接不能的关键区别（样例 01 中 `cid=7` 无匹配客户仍保留）。\n\n### 5.3 规则 E-RIGHT\n\nE-LEFT 的镜像：`π_S ( R RIGHT JOIN S ON R.a = S.b ) ≡ π_S ( S )`，前提是 `R.a` 为可信唯一键。\n\n### 5.4 规则 E-INNER（消除 INNER JOIN 的一侧）\n\n计划：`π_R ( R INNER JOIN S ON R.a = S.b )`。内连接会**丢弃未匹配的 R 行**，因此除 P1–P4 外还需要：\n\n- **P5** `R.a`（保留侧连接列）有**可信 NOT NULL**；\n- **P6** `R.a → S.b` 是**可信外键**（引用前述唯一键）。\n\n证明。内连接中 r 出现当且仅当 m(r)=1（由引理 m(r)≤1）。m(r)=1 又当且仅当\nr.a 非空（由 P5 恒成立）且 S 中存在 b=r.a 的父行（由 P6 外键恒成立）。\n于是每行 r 都恰好匹配一次，\n\n```\nπ_R ( R ⋈_{a=b} S )  ≡  π_R ( R )\n```\n\n缺少 P5 或 P6 任一条，未匹配行都会被内连接删除，消除不安全（见测试 10、11）。\n\n### 5.5 保守性（元数据缺失 / 不可信）\n\n- 找不到匹配的唯一键/非空/外键元数据 → `REJECTED_NO_METADATA`，保留连接；\n- 元数据存在但 `trust=\"untrusted\"`（或缺省）→ `REJECTED_UNTRUSTED`，保留连接并给出原因；\n- `policy=\"validate_all\"` 下还会用实际数据复查每条前提，违反则\n  `REJECTED_VIOLATED`（如重复键、悬空外键、非空列为 null）；\n- 非等值连接、CROSS JOIN、被消除侧不是基表、FULL OUTER JOIN → `REJECTED_STRUCTURAL` / 保留；\n- `forceUnsafeRewrite=true` 时才会忽略信任前提改写，判定记为 `UNSAFE_FORCED`，\n  引擎随后的双计划比对通常会直接证伪它（测试 14）。\n\n多连接计划自底向上逐一判定；“列是否被连接外部使用”按从根到该连接路径上的引用计算\n（因此上层过滤引用了被消除侧列也会阻止消除，见测试 04）。\n\n---\n\n## 6. 信任模型与两种策略\n\n- **`trust_catalog`（默认）**：只把 `trust=\"trusted\"` 的声明当作证明前提；不可信即拒绝。\n  它不读数据来验证声明——若声明“可信”但数据其实违反（例如重复键），改写会发生，\n  此时引擎执行两个计划并以多重集比对**证伪**，在 `equivalence.proven=false` 与\n  `counterexample` 中暴露差异（测试 08：原计划 4 行 vs 改写 3 行）。\n- **`validate_all`**：在信任判定之外，对每条前提约束在已加载数据上做一次校验，\n  任何违反都阻止改写（测试 07、10、11，样例 05）。\n\n这区分了“**声明是否可信**”和“**声明在当前数据上是否成立**”两件事。\n\n---\n\n## 7. 验收：小表上的安全规则验证（均为实际运行结果）\n\n经典小表：`customers(id,name)`、`orders(oid,cid,amount)`，含一个无匹配客户的订单 `cid=7`。\n\n| # | 场景 | 判定 | 等价证明 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 样例01 | LEFT JOIN，`customers.id` 可信主键，只投影 orders 列 | **REMOVED (E-LEFT)** | proven=true，3=3 行（cid=7 保留） |\n| 样例02 | 投影用到 `c.name` | KEPT：列仍被引用 | proven=true |\n| 样例03 | 主键声明 `trust=untrusted` | **REJECTED_UNTRUSTED**，原因输出 | proven=true（保留即安全） |\n| 样例04 | 无任何约束元数据 | **REJECTED_NO_METADATA**，原因输出 | proven=true |\n| 样例05 | validate_all，customers 有重复 id=2 | **REJECTED_VIOLATED**：duplicate key | proven=true（5=5，连接保留） |\n| 样例06 | INNER JOIN + NOT NULL(cid) + FK + 唯一键，全部匹配 | **REMOVED (E-INNER)** | proven=true，3=3 |\n| 样例07 | validate 动作：orders.cid=9 悬空 | 报告 FK `holds=false` | — |\n\n样例 01 的真实判定输出：\n\n```\njoinsRemoved: 1\nequivalence: {\"proven\": true, \"originalRowCount\": 3, \"rewrittenRowCount\": 3}\n decision: J1 left E-LEFT -> REMOVED | all premises satisfied; join provably redundant\n```\n\n样例 03（不可信约束被拒绝）：\n\n```\ndecision: J1 left E-LEFT -> REJECTED_UNTRUSTED |\n  constraint pk_customers is marked trust=untrusted;\n  an untrusted uniqueness guarantee cannot justify elimination\n```\n\n样例 05（数据违反约束，validate_all 拒绝）：\n\n```\ndecision: J1 left E-LEFT -> REJECTED_VIOLATED |\n  constraint violated by the data: duplicate key (id=2) in customers\n  — example row {\"id\":2,\"name\":\"Bob2\"}\n```\n\n样例 07（validate 动作）：\n\n```\nallHold: False\n  pk_customers       PRIMARY KEY holds=True\n  nn_orders_cid      NOT NULL    holds=True\n  fk_orders_customers FOREIGN KEY holds=False\n    -> row in orders has no matching parent in customers for key (cid)\n```\n\n复现命令：\n\n```bash\njava -cp out oj.Main run samples/01_left_join_safe.json\njava -cp out oj.Main run samples/03_left_join_untrusted.json\njava -cp out oj.Main run samples/05_left_join_violated_validate.json\njava -cp out oj.Main run samples/07_validate_action.json\n```\n\n---\n\n## 8. 数据与执行计划导出\n\n所有响应都是 JSON，可直接重定向导出；`query`/`explain` 响应包含：\n\n- `planOriginal` / `planRewritten`：改写前后的完整计划树；\n- `decisions[]`：每个连接的规则、结果、人类可读原因、逐条前提及满足情况；\n- `equivalence`：`proven`、两侧行数，失败时含 `counterexample.onlyInOriginal/onlyInRewritten`；\n- `result`：改写计划的 `columns`、`rowCount`、`rows`（`explain` 不含此字段）。\n\n```bash\njava -cp out oj.Main run samples/01_left_join_safe.json > /tmp/result.json\n```\n\n---\n\n## 9. 自动化测试与运行记录\n\n命令（在项目根目录）：\n\n```bash\n$ java trust_catalog produces a counterexample\nPASS 09 safe inner join eliminated with NOT NULL + FK + unique\nPASS 10 inner join with unmatched non-null FK is kept under validate_all\nPASS 11 inner join with NULL cid: without NOT NULL metadata elimination is rejected\nPASS 12 right outer join eliminated by symmetric E-RIGHT rule\nPASS 13 non-equi join is never eliminated\nPASS 14 forceUnsafeRewrite
